turns.q: Which district had the most households completing 100 days in FY 2022-23?
turns.answer: Highest households 100 days (MGNREGA, Meghalaya, FY 2022-23): East Garo Hills, 22,049. Next: South Garo Hills (9,969), then South West Khasi Hills (7,778).
turns.sql:
/* metric:mgnrega_households_100_days ranking */ SELECT lgd_district AS district, SUM(households_completed_100_days) AS households_100_days
FROM curated.v_employment
WHERE year_key = 2022 AND lgd_district IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY lgd_district ORDER BY households_100_days DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

turns.q: CM Elevate Legacy: number of records, subsidy disbursed, scheme with most records?
turns.answer:
Across all financial years for Meghalaya under CM Elevate Legacy, there are 2,823 records with ₹52.57 crore disbursed as subsidy.

Highest records (CM Elevate Legacy, Meghalaya, across all financial years): Meghalaya Piggery Development Scheme, 1,353. Next: Meghalaya Poultry Farming Scheme (454), then Meghalaya Sericulture & Weaving Scheme (Spinning) (198).

Note: CM Elevate Legacy amounts are provisional, and the money unit has not been verified by the department.

results.src: UAT Passed Questions PDF (30 Oct 2026) PMAY-OFF-006

turns.q: Give me the house status breakdown for GABIL SONGGITCHAM.
turns.answer: House status breakdown (345 houses) in Gabil Songgitcham village (Bajengdoba block, North Garo Hills), across all financial years (FY 2017-18 to FY 2023-24): Completed 179, Roof Cast 91, Plinth 73, House Sanctioned 2. This is the PMAY-G figure across all financial years.
turns.rewritten: What is the house status breakdown for GABIL SONGGITCHAM?
turns.sql:
SELECT
  village_code AS entity_key,
  MAX(lgd_village_name) AS name,
  MAX(lgd_block) AS block,
  MAX(lgd_district) AS district,
  COUNT(*) AS houses,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount), 0) AS sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)), 0) AS released,
  COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(amount_released, 0)) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS released_on_sanctioned,
  COALESCE(SUM(sanctioned_amount) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0), 0) AS sanctioned_positive,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_completed) AS completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS incomplete,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name IS NULL) AS no_status,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0 AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS full_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) < sanctioned_amount) AS part_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    COALESCE(amount_released, 0) = 0) AS no_release,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount
    AND NOT COALESCE(is_completed, FALSE)) AS full_not_done,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sanction_no) AS sanction_numbers,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    is_placeholder) AS placeholders,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed') AS st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Completed'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_completed,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast') AS st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Roof Cast'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_roof_cast,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth') AS st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Plinth'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_plinth,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned') AS st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'House Sanctioned'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_house_sanctioned,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)') AS st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Existing site(Old House)'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_existing_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site') AS st_proposed_site,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
    status_name = 'Proposed Site'
    AND sanctioned_amount > 0
    AND COALESCE(amount_released, 0) >= sanctioned_amount) AS fnd_st_proposed_site
FROM curated.v_pmay
WHERE
  village_code = ANY(
    ARRAY[275189]
  )
GROUP BY
  village_code
